name: ICONIQ Growth
history: ICONIQ was founded in San Francisco in 2011 by Divesh Makan, Michael Anders and Chad Boeding as a wealth manager for technology founders, and its growth funds began investing in 2013 under Will Griffith. They backed Snowflake, Datadog, Airbnb, Adyen and Robinhood before those companies went public. Its seventh growth fund closed at $5.75 billion in 2024, and the track record on this page covers the growth funds' minority stakes only, not client accounts.
investment_concept: “The future is built by extraordinary people.”
